description: K8up is a Kubernetes backup operator that orchestrates scheduled and on-demand backup, restore, check, archive, and prune jobs using Restic. The root scope coordinates command-line entrypoints, Kubernetes custom resource definitions and reconciliation controllers, Restic wrapper execution inside workload pods, and archive/restore support utilities.

components.name: Operator Controllers
components.description: Reconciles backup, restore, archive, check, prune, and schedule CRDs and manages execution of corresponding Kubernetes jobs.

components.name: Backup Controller
components.description: Reconciles Backup custom resources and manages the execution of volume backup pods and pre-backup tasks.

components.name: Job and Locking Infrastructure
components.description: Provides shared configuration access, batch job lifecycle and status management, repository locking, and Prometheus metrics.

components.name: Schedule Controller
components.description: Reconciles Schedule custom resources to evaluate cron intervals and dispatch periodic backup and maintenance tasks.

components.name: Reconciler Framework and Scheduler
components.description: Provides generic controller reconciliation loops, cron job scheduling facilities, and Kubernetes volume utilities.

components.name: Archive Controller
components.description: Reconciles Archive custom resources and executes repository archive batch jobs.

components.name: Check Controller
components.description: Reconciles Check custom resources and coordinates repository integrity verification jobs.

components.name: Generic Execution and Cleanup Support
components.description: Provides generic pod execution helpers, container environment variable resolution, and finished job cleanup.

components.name: Prune Controller
components.description: Reconciles Prune custom resources and executes repository snapshot pruning jobs.

components.name: Restore Controller
components.description: Reconciles Restore custom resources and coordinates data restoration jobs to target volumes.
